reviews.text: This my second purchase. These are the best pads i’ve ever tried. My skin feels smooth and brighter after each use.
reviews.zh: 第二次回購。呢款係我用過最好嘅棉片。每次用完皮膚都覺得滑同埋亮白咗。

reviews.text:
These rice toner pads are really good. They come with a generous amount in the package, which is great value. The pads themselves are large, soft, and well soaked with essence, making them very refreshing to use on the skin.
They feel hydrating and soothing, and I like how evenly they apply the product without wasting any. My skin feels calmer and more balanced after using them, and they work well as part of my daily skincare routine.
Overall, I’m very satisfied with them and think they’re a great essential to keep on hand. The quantity and quality make them definitely worth repurchasing.
reviews.zh:
呢款米水柔膚棉真係好好用。包裝入面份量十足，抵到爛。棉片本身大張、柔軟，而且精華浸透晒，敷上面好清爽。
用落保濕又舒緩，我鍾意佢可以均勻咁搽成塊面，唔會嘥。用完之後皮膚感覺穩定咗、平衡返晒，融入我每日護膚流程完全冇問題。
整體嚟講我好滿意，覺得屋企一定要長期擺定一盒。份量同質素都絕對值得回購。

reviews.text: I had already been using the carrot pads and wanted to try the rice pads, so I bought a set that included both. After using them, I personally found the carrot pads to be more hydrating and better.
reviews.zh: 我本身已經用緊胡蘿蔔片，一直想試吓米水片，所以直接買咗一set兩款都有。用落之後，我自己就覺得胡蘿蔔片保濕效果更好，整體表現亦更勝一籌。

reviews.text: Less toner than the varrot pads but still gentle and soft on the skin! I found it slightly cooler than the carrot pad and easier to separate. Would purchase again!
reviews.zh: 精華量比 varrot 片少，但仍然係溫和又柔軟！我覺得佢比胡蘿蔔片涼浸浸少少，而且更容易分開一張張用。會再回購！

reviews.text: really good really helped even out my skin tone and helped with brightening seen a lot of changes with my skin and it’s been the best I recommend this for people who have temperamental skin acne oily or dry skin
reviews.zh: 真係好好用，幫我均勻咗膚色，亦有提亮效果，皮膚有明顯改善，係我用過最好嘅一款。推薦畀膚質唔穩定、爆瘡、油性或者乾性皮膚嘅人用。

reviews.text: First, I want to say that I ADORE the carrot toner pads. They are my holy grail and go to! The carrot formulation has really helped my skin tone and reduce redness. Unfortunately, the rice formula made me breakout. My skin doesn’t like rice formulations of any kind. I gave them to my friend who I know enjoys the rice toner pads.
reviews.zh: 首先我想講，我勁鍾意胡蘿蔔柔膚棉，佢係我嘅命定之選！胡蘿蔔配方真係幫到我均勻膚色、減淡泛紅。可惜米水配方令我爆瘡，我嘅皮膚對任何米水配方都唔受控。我已經轉咗畀我朋友，佢一向鍾意用米水柔膚棉。

reviews.text: にんじんとの違いは香りぐらいしか分からなかったけど、2枚にさけてパックも拭き取りもできるので、やはりスキンフード最強！似たようなパッド使ってましたが、1枚取る時に境目が分からなくて取りにくかったけど、スキンフードはちゃんと1枚ずつ取れるの使いやすい！
reviews.zh: 同胡蘿蔔嗰款比起嚟，除咗香味之外我唔覺得有咩分別，不過可以一分為二，敷喺面上得、抹都得，Skin Food 真係最強！我之前用過類似嘅棉片，撕嘅時候成日揾唔到分界線，好難撕開，但 Skin Food 嗰啲可以一張一張咁撕出嚟，真係好用！

reviews.text:
The SKINFOOD Rice Brightening Pad is an excellent addition to any skincare routine, especially for those seeking to brighten and even out their complexion. Each pad is saturated with a gentle formula containing rice extract, known for its skin-brightening and hydrating properties. The texture of the pad is soft yet textured enough to provide a light exfoliation, helping to remove dead skin cells without being abrasive.

After just a few uses, my skin felt smoother, more radiant, and had a noticeable glow. It also helped fade dark spots and hyperpigmentation over time. The formula is gentle on the skin and doesn't cause irritation, even for those with sensitive skin. Plus, the convenient pad format makes it easy to apply the product evenly across the face without any mess.

Overall, I highly recommend the SKINFOOD Rice Brightening Pad for anyone looking to enhance their skincare routine with a product that delivers brightening, exfoliating..
reviews.zh:
SKINFOOD Rice Brightening Pad 係任何護膚程序嘅絕佳補充，尤其適合想提亮、均勻膚色嘅人。每片棉片都浸透咗含有米萃取嘅溫和配方，米萃取一向以提亮同保濕功效見稱。棉片質地柔軟，但同時帶有適量紋理可以做到輕微去角質，幫助清走老廢角質之餘又唔會刮損皮膚。

用咗幾次之後，皮膚明顯變得平滑、有光澤，仲有肉眼可見嘅光感。隨住持續使用，痘印同色斑都慢慢淡咗。配方非常溫和，就算敏感肌都用得，唔會刺激。加上一片片嘅設計用起上嚟好方便，可以均勻咁搽勻成塊面，唔會黐手。

整體嚟講，我強烈推薦 SKINFOOD Rice Brightening Pad 畀任何想加強護膚程序、達到提亮同去角質效果嘅人..

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
